title.narrative: Providing integrated support services (primary healthcare, NFIs, and MSME) for the most vulnerable group in rural Aleppo

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThis proposal aims to support targeted integrated within encompasses multi-sector (health shelter/NFI ErL) to optimize impact and deliver integrated assistance, that beneficiaries will receive services from three sectors, where medical services will be provided to beneficiaries, along with winter clothing to face the cold winter, in addition to providing financial grants to professionals and farmers.ltbrgtltbgtltugtHealth:lt/ugtlt/bgtltbrgtPublic health is likely to remain a critical issue in conjunction with this difficult economic crisis especially in the countryside of Aleppo.ltbrgtThis section aims to ensure integrated package of life-saving and life-sustaining response at a primary and secondary health care levels to about ltbgt22.900lt/bgt beneficiaries through:ltbrgtOne mobile team: (through mobile clinic was previously equipped by SHF) includes four medical specialties: internal, gynecology, pediatric, and general, and the clinic includes: Portable echo, ECG, X-Ray device.ltbrgtIn addition to have a highly qualified medical staff with previous experience.ltbrgtThis equipped mobile clinic will give us speed in providing medical services in the countryside in addition to limit the movement of beneficiaries between the countryside and the city.ltbrgtProviding primary and secondary health care: through referral system.ltbrgtProviding MHPSS and health education.ltbrgtltbgtltugtErL:lt/ugtlt/bgtltbrgtMany skilled professionals no longer have the ability to acquire the operational tools for their workshops, and many farmers in the countryside are unable to secure a source of energy to irrigate their agricultural lands, and there are those who need a financial grant to start a small project such as livestock breeding, also support industrial workshops with raw materials or equipment (Based on ErL sector recommendations and after AAP procedures)ltbrgtThis project aims to provide financial grants to 53 beneficiaries through provision of support grants for existing MSMEs.ltbrgtMechanism of Action:ltbrgtDuring the first three months of the project: the beneficiaries will be evaluated to classify the needs.ltbrgtIn the 4th and 5th months of the project, selected beneficiaries will be contacted.ltbrgtIn the 5th and 6th months of the project, contracts will be signed with the selected beneficiaries.ltbrgtIn the 9th, 10th, and 11th months of the project, financial grants will be distributed to beneficiaries and an agreement will be reached on the implementation period, which should not exceed 15 days from the date of receipt of the grant.ltbrgtIn the sixth, seventh, eighth and ninth months of the project: the mobile teams visit the beneficiaries at their workplaces to ensure that they benefit from the grant for the purpose set for it and the continuity of benefit.ltbrgtltbgtltugtShelters / NFIs:lt/ugtlt/bgtltbrgtThere is an urgent need to provide winter clothing due to the very high prices of winter clothes due to the poor economic situation due to the conditions of the long war.ltbrgtMechanism of Action:ltbrgtThe mobile teams will visit the targeted areas, conduct surveys, visit the beneficiaries in their homes (the most vulnerable groups).ltbrgtDuring the first three months of the project, detailed assessment of the actual needs for the beneficiaries will be done.ltbrgtThen, the beneficiaries will be divided into three segments (men, women, and children “boys girls”), each segment will have a special kitltbrgtDuring the11th to15th months of the project the kits (through cash vouchers) will be distributed to about 1.625 beneficiaries, (the distribution was delayed until winter due to the changing conditions in the country, in addition to the delay in the arrival of the financial payment), where contracts will be signed with suppliers in the service delivery areas, in order to reduce the burden of transportation on beneficiaries (vouchers will be distributed at the same times as the mobile medical team visits).ltbrgtIn the months (11-12-13-14-15) of the project, beneficiaries will be followed up to obtain feedback from them on the project services.ltbrgtwe have enough experience in a previous project (SYR-21/DDA-3558/RA2/S/NFI/NGO/20303).ltbrgtlt/pgt
